name: Karen Rimmer
prior_offices: Converse County clerk (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed on the official clerk page)
background: Karen Rimmer is the Converse County clerk and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official clerk page lists her in that office, and the official general election summary lists her as the winner of the clerk race.
